'''Mike Lynch Grrr (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Mike Lynch]] posted on DeckTech on 1 December 2001 about [[November 2001 Berkeley tournament]].<ref name="tr-d3130">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-01-grrrd3130/ grrr], DeckTech (Mike "Hangmann" Lynch, 1 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-01-grrrd3130/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Mike Lynch's note that DeckTech lost his first tournament report; he went 2–4 at the November 2001 Berkeley tournament and pulled a Depa Billaba from his prizes. The rewritten report is [[Mike Lynch Would the Real TR Please Stand Up (tournament report)]].

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Mike Lynch]] (byline: Mike "Hangmann" Lynch)

* '''Report title:''' ''Grrr''
* '''Event:''' [[November 2001 Berkeley tournament]]
* '''Event date:''' 18 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Berkley, CA
* '''Record:''' 2–4

== Original report ==

'''grrr'''
* '''Author:''' Mike "Hangmann" Lynch
* '''Published:''' Dec 1, 2001

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  I had written a not so bad first toruament report but Deck Tech ate it with their stupid "can’t be logged in for more than 10 minutes becaue I don’t know how to program cookies" login system



I went 2 and 4 in my first tournament ever, pulled a Depa Billba from my prizes



Thanks to my friend Eugene for driving



The other one was much longer and I don’t feel like typing it again.
</nowiki></div>
